observation.visible_scene: A wide landscape view: a rugged tan-and-brown mountain ridge, with small snow patches on the upper-left summit, rises above a calm, dark lake. The ridge is mirrored almost perfectly in the still water filling the lower half of the frame. In the lower-left foreground are a few green coniferous trees and a band of pale dry grass; the bottom-right water shows a bright reflection of the overcast sky.
visible_changes: The framing, ridge silhouette, foreground trees and grass band hold identical positions from the first to the last sample, so there is no detectable camera pan/tilt and no object translation.
The lake surface remains glassy throughout; the mirror reflection of the mountain persists as a stable reflection (not a second ridge) with no visible ripple, deformation or distortion.
No object enters or exits the scene; the bright sky-reflection patch at the bottom right keeps the same shape across all frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: Any later wind or disturbance that might break the reflection is not shown within this segment.
The terrain and shoreline beyond the left and right edges of the frame are unseen.
uncertain_details: Sub-pixel shimmer on the water surface cannot be confirmed at this resolution and frame spacing.
Whether the camera is fully locked off or drifting imperceptibly slowly is not fully determinable from these frames alone.
